mapper.sql: id, title, content, type, priority, publisher_id, status, publish_time, expire_time, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.name as publisher_name FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.publisher_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT a.*, u.name as publisher_name FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.publisher_id = u.id ORDER BY a.priority DESC, a.publish_time DESC
SELECT a.*, u.name as publisher_name FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.publisher_id = u.id ORDER BY a.priority DESC, a.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{size}
SELECT a.*, u.name as publisher_name FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.publisher_id = u.id WHERE a.type = #{type} ORDER BY a.priority DESC, a.publish_time DESC

SELECT a.*, u.name as publisher_name FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.publisher_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND (a.expire_time IS NULL OR a.expire_time > NOW()) ORDER BY a.priority DESC, a.publish_time DESC
